observations: Photo 0-2 show a white cab-over truck with an orange drilling mast/derrick mounted on the rear chassis, raised at an angle.
A red cylindrical tank (likely a water/mud tank or air compressor) is mounted on the left side of the truck.
Visible surface rust and weathering on the mast framework and cab.
A badge on the cab grille (photo 1) is visible but not legible enough to read a brand name.
License plate is present but digits are not clearly legible in any photo.
No engine, hydraulic system, drill bits, mud pump, or control panel close-ups are shown.
No video or photo showing the rig operating, mast extending, or engine running.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'LOVE PAUL' overlay all three photos; these are platform/user marks, not proof of condition.

proof_requests: A video of the engine starting and the mast being raised/lowered through full range of motion
A video of the compressor/mud pump running under load
Close-up photos of the mast welds and joints for rust/structural assessment
Photo of all drill rods, bits, and tools included in the sale, laid out together
Photo of vehicle registration/ownership documents and any service receipts
Photo of the hour-meter or logbook showing usage history
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig, but every seller claim of working condition, servicing, and completeness is unverifiable from the photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case (non-working, incomplete, undocumented) pending the listed proofs.
